title: Self-supervised Adversarial Purification for Graph Neural Networks
summary: Two established paper/release specification discrepancies. Non-equivalence does not by itself refute a stated core optimization or restoration guarantee; no such dependency is established. Conditional convergence arithmetic is valid with an invariant contraction domain.
limitations: No author-code execution or benchmark reproduction
No original experiment commit correspondence established
No later manuscript or erratum inspected
Separate OpenReview attachments unresolved after staged acquisition HTTP 403

problems.title: Printed restoration objective differs from implemented BCE

claim.location: PDF p6 Eq9; p18 Algorithm1; experiment.py lines240-250
claim.paraphrase: Minimize the sum of positive-edge log(1-p) and injected-edge log(p), plus symmetry loss.

assumptions: Original edges positive, injected nonedges negative
Equal mean contributions; shared final decoder bias is an admissible parameter restriction
Directional equality makes symmetry penalty zero

check.kind: analytic identity plus independent scalar computation and static source inspection
check.input: One equally weighted positive and negative score share p=sigmoid(z).
check.stated_result: log(p)+log(1-p), derivative with respect to z=1-2p
check.decisive_output: At p=0.9 derivatives -0.8 and 0.8, respectively; objectives have opposite ordering relative to p=0.5.

counterevidence: Printed objective moves independently adjustable class scores toward correct boundaries.
The shared-bias restriction does not force the full trained model to remain there.
Released BCE is valid and does not prove historical experimental implementation.
problems.impact: A substantive loss-specification discrepancy. Equation9 is not explicitly identified as BCE, and no stated universal optimization/restoration guarantee is refuted by objective non-equivalence alone. Minor reflects the bounded demonstrated claim, not a requirement for benchmark score loss.

correction.statement: Use negative mean log(p) on original edges and negative mean log(1-p) on injected edges to match release; keep symmetry term.
correction.verification: Algebra and static call correspondence verified only

acceptance_check.truth_and_assumptions: Equation (9), Algorithm 1 and the released BCE have different signs and roles. The shared sigmoid example is admissible in the stated/released architecture.
acceptance_check.decisive_evidence_and_counterevidence: At p=0.9 the parameter derivatives are -0.8 and +0.8. Independently adjustable edge scores still move toward their correct class boundaries; that counterevidence prevents a universal restoration-failure claim.
acceptance_check.core_dependency_and_severity: Minor: an established objective/specification discrepancy; no stated universal core optimization or restoration guarantee is refuted by this restricted shared-parameter witness.
acceptance_check.correction_scope: The BCE replacement is algebraically identified; historical experiment provenance and empirical effects remain unverified.

problems.title: Released convergence test permits cancellation

claim.location: PDF p6 Section5.3 and p18 Algorithm2; gprgae.py lines151-157
claim.paraphrase: Stop using relative norm of update with threshold1e-3, whereas source uses relative absolute change of total mass and1e-4.

assumptions: Undirected three-node graph with two positive edge weights
Old edges0.2 and0.8, new0.8 and0.2; mirrored directed entries
All weights in sigmoid range; alpha=1 as paper default

check.kind: independent arithmetic and static source inspection
check.stated_result: Norm test rejects: Frobenius update ratio1.0289915108550531>1e-3

counterevidence: No claim that this exact transition occurred in trained purifier
problems.impact: Predicate equivalence is false; historical stopping times and accuracy impact unresolved.

correction.statement: Retain old edge vector and evaluate the declared norm of the vector difference divided by the same old-vector norm, with explicit zero convention.
correction.verification: Predicate algebra only; author code unchanged

acceptance_check.truth_and_assumptions: The specified norm-relative stopping test differs from the released relative change of total edge mass.
acceptance_check.decisive_evidence_and_counterevidence: The symmetric 0.2/0.8 swap has zero total-mass change but norm-relative update 1.02899151. Nonnegative individual edge weights do not prevent cancellation between updates.
acceptance_check.core_dependency_and_severity: Minor: a released stopping-predicate discrepancy. The independent values are a predicate counterexample, not a demonstrated learned trajectory or benchmark failure.
acceptance_check.correction_scope: Use the specified norm on the difference and retain a genuine previous iterate; analytical repair only.

scope_clarifications.text: Partition must be uniformly unaffected across maximization domain; contraction requires an invariant complete domain. Sufficient clean-fixed-point ball conditions verified. No false theorem claimed.
100 sampled ratios support sampled behavior but cannot upper-bound the Lipschitz supremum.
